title: Adding Suppliers & Distributor Profiles (GSTIN & State Code)

intro.title: Adding Supplier Profiles
intro.subtitle: Distributor master onboarding, 15-digit GSTIN state codes, wholesale drug licenses, and credit terms

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 5, Part 1: Adding Suppliers and Distributor Profiles. Proper supplier master setup ensures seamless GST input tax credit and drug controller licensing compliance.
From the dashboard navigation, click Suppliers, then select New Supplier to open the distributor profile form.
Enter the distributor agency name, primary contact person, and phone number for purchase coordination.
In the Statutory section, enter the supplier's 15-digit GSTIN and wholesale Drug Licence Number. MediFlow validates the state code prefix for automated IGST or CGST/SGST tax routing.
Set default trade terms such as thirty credit days and opening balance. Click Save Supplier to register the distributor for purchase orders and inward GRNs.

outro.takeaway: Supplier Profiles: Register pharmaceutical distributors with verified GSTIN, state codes, and drug licenses for compliant inward purchase billing.
